title: 真实Git process filter v2：长驻pkt-line、多包内容与delay最终取回，失败阻断错误工作树
body:
## 操作任务
实现serve(inp,out)处理Git二进制filter协议v2。握手git-filter-client/version2，响应server/version2；协商clean/smudge/delay。每请求完整读header组与content组后才响应；clean把UTF8 JSON转键排序紧凑JSON加换行，smudge转排序indent2 JSON加换行，空内容保持空。成功响应status组、内容组、最终空status组共三次flush；错误仅status=error组，不污染stdout、不退出长驻进程。smudge遇文件basename以deferred开头且can-delay=1时缓存结果、回delayed；list_available_blobs不读内容，返回所有待取pathname组再success状态组；Git随后空内容请求必须取回并清除缓存，不能报告空列表丢弃未决路径。offline.json转换不可用时error；畸形帧显式异常，正常请求间EOF退出。帧≤65520字节、请求≤1MiB。平台实际required process filter处理多文件同进程，>64KiB和空文件，原生Git trace确认delay最终完成；单路径clean/checkout失败不得污染已暂存blob或留下可用占位文件。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Git filter-process v2/索引/checkout-index与本地Python长驻进程，只在自建临时仓库。延迟结果在本地即就绪并走完整通知/重取协议，offline路径为明确教学不可用输入；未访问远端转换服务，不证明真实网络超时重连或任意二进制转换。与一次性clean/smudge题区别在双向pkt-line、长驻复用和delay闭环；无OpsForge真实Git历史/推送或默认身份变更。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,tempfile,pathlib,subprocess,shlex,json,hashlib,io
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')};env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Fixture',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Fixture',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid')
def git(repo,*args,ok=True):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','commit.gpgsign=false','-c','core.hooksPath='+os.devnull,'-c','maintenance.auto=false','-C',str(repo),*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=7)
 if ok:assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
 return p
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-process-filter-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);repo=root/'repo';repo.mkdir();git(repo,'init','--object-format=sha1','-b','main')
 wrapper=root/'process filter with spaces.py';pidlog=root/'filter-pids.log'
 wrapper.write_text('import sys,os\nsys.path.insert(0,'+repr(str(pathlib.Path(task.__file__).parent))+')\nimport task\nwith open('+repr(str(pidlog))+',"a") as log:log.write(str(os.getpid())+"\\n")\ntask.serve(sys.stdin.buffer,sys.stdout.buffer)\n')
 git(repo,'config','filter.longjson.process',shlex.quote(sys.executable)+' -B '+shlex.quote(str(wrapper)))
 git(repo,'config','filter.longjson.required','true');(repo/'.gitattributes').write_text('*.json filter=longjson\n')
 values={'first file.json':{'z':2,'a':'UTF8中文'},'deferred file.json':{'payload':'x'*70000,'id':9007199254740993},'last.json':{'tail':True},'empty.json':None}
 for name,value in values.items():(repo/name).write_text('' if value is None else json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:actual_git_process_filter_v2_multi_request_delay_lifecycle',flush=True)
 added=git(repo,'add','.',ok=False);assert added.returncode==0,added.stderr
 assert len(pidlog.read_text().splitlines())==1,'multiple paths were not processed in one long-lived filter'
 for name,value in values.items():
  actual=git(repo,'show',':'+name).stdout
  expected='' if value is None else json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n'
  assert actual==expected,'index did not contain canonical clean bytes'
 git(repo,'commit','-m','fixture filtered files');config=(repo/'.git/config').read_bytes()
 for name in values:(repo/name).unlink()
 packet_trace=root/'packet-trace.log';env['GIT_TRACE_PACKET']=str(packet_trace)
 checked=git(repo,'checkout','--','.',ok=False);env.pop('GIT_TRACE_PACKET')
 assert checked.returncode==0,checked.stderr
 trace=packet_trace.read_text(errors='replace')
 assert 'status=delayed' in trace and 'command=list_available_blobs' in trace,'actual Git delay protocol was not exercised'
 for name,value in values.items():
  expected='' if value is None else json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n'
  assert (repo/name).read_text()==expected,'delayed or multi-packet smudge returned placeholder/incomplete content'
 old=git(repo,'rev-parse',':last.json').stdout;(repo/'last.json').write_text('not-json')
 failed=git(repo,'add','last.json',ok=False);assert failed.returncode!=0,'required converter error was silently accepted'
 assert git(repo,'rev-parse',':last.json').stdout==old,'failed clean overwrote last valid staged content'
 # A declared unavailable conversion is a failed checkout, never an accepted placeholder.
 blob=git(repo,'rev-parse',':first file.json').stdout.strip();git(repo,'update-index','--add','--cacheinfo','100644,'+blob+',offline.json')
 failed=git(repo,'checkout-index','--force','--','offline.json',ok=False);assert failed.returncode!=0
 assert not (repo/'offline.json').exists(),'failed required conversion left a usable placeholder worktree file'
 assert (repo/'.git/config').read_bytes()==config
 # A malformed protocol header must fail explicitly; ordinary EOF between requests remains valid.
 try:task.serve(io.BytesIO(b'zzzz'),io.BytesIO())
 except (ValueError,EOFError):pass
 else:raise AssertionError('malformed pkt-line was silently treated as success')
 print('NATIVE_GIT_PROCESS_V2_ONE_PROCESS_BIG_AND_EMPTY_CONTENT_DELAY_FULFILLED_REQUIRED_FAILURE_PRESERVES_INDEX',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
